description: This file defines the RDSDataServiceClient class for interfacing with AWS RDS DataService, providing methods for executing SQL statements and managing transactions.

classes.name: RDSDataServiceClient
classes.description: Client class providing methods to interact with AWS RDS DataService API, extending from AwsClient.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatement
methods.description: Executes a batch of SQL statements synchronously.

methods.name: batchExecuteStatementAsync
methods.description: Executes a batch of SQL statements asynchronously.

methods.name: beginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction synchronously.

methods.name: beginTransactionAsync
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction asynchronously.

methods.name: executeStatement
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement synchronously.

methods.name: executeStatementAsync
methods.description: Executes a single SQL statement asynchronously.
